findings: The earlier missing-original conclusion checked the default main branch, not the master branch explicitly named in the original URL. master remains available; its exact original script, GPLv3 license and README license statement were retrieved at the same immutable commit.

The user-supplied MIT authorization supplies the stated basis for the ddgksf2013 contributions. It is not treated as overriding GPLv3 on the original.
MIT and BSD-3-Clause notices and readable library sources are retained alongside the combined GPLv3 distribution.
The stored runtime file prepends a dated distribution/attribution notice only; stripping that notice reproduces every upstream byte.
The private confirmation remains user-supplied evidence, with the identity/version authentication limit recorded above.
